note: Crimson Halo Glass transfer test on renders/plates/doctor (9.97 s, two tight takes of a dentist in a teal clinic, jump cut at frame 138). MCU-only source: the teal set is replaced by the crimson seamless studio (crimson-studio wide/mcu), the persistent halo is drawn plate-locked with the reference WIDE's screen size at the wide rest scale (persistentProps.sunburst-halo.restScale) and occluded by the presenter, and the plate vignette adds a side falloff over the wides. Wide = plate x0.53 (head ~250 px, head top ~34% H; flip x1.9 against the x1.0 tight); crimson-talent despills, darkens the matte edge toward the red wrap and feathers the plate edges. Compressed narrative (template rows 1, 3, 6, 9+11): [S1 0-1.85 WS] hook: pullback-expo-open 1.69x + settle-float, world-locked rose-sheen hook word + short red ghost echo, frosted arch over the plate's lower edge with the translucent red ghost word under the glass and a thin kashida line on top -> [S2 1.85-4.58 MCU] validation: fade-rise hero (words gated to their own start) + a 92 px pink light band sweeping R->L and leaving before the cut + smoked pill over the scrubs pocket + typed Light subtitle -> [S3 4.58-6.61 WS, jump cut] agitation: Difference question on the cut frame across the neck and wall (cyan over red, teal over skin), thin kashida word drawn behind the head, word swap with a 1-frame gap to a ghost word behind the hair, red Difference slam on its spoken onset -> [S4 6.61-9.97 MS->WS] brand + CTA: pullback-brand delivers the world-locked silver wordmark + red script, hairline CTA capsule + typed bold label, ~1.3 s end hold. SFX: the arch click is the engine's clickHF (style rule, autoSfx); the typing rattle is baked into the bed (make_bed.py --sfx typing@2.34) because the peak-normalised engine train cannot reach the reference level, so that one cue is opted out. Cuts are static camera cues (engine v2 cues are cuts); the hook and brand pull-backs carry worldRest so world-locked type lands on its slot. render.mjs --out keeps all 299 frames.
